remarks:
Looking for a luxury ranch with acreage, exceptional entertaining space, and a heated commercial shop? Welcome to 6428 Bartz Rd, where custom craftsmanship meets unmatched versatility on 3.6 private acres in the Starpoint School District. This 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers 2,936 sq ft of beautifully finished living space, a detached 5-car garage, and an impressive 4,300 sq ft heated commercial-style building that's ideal for car collectors, contractors, hobbyists, or business owners.

Inside, radiant in-floor heat warms both the main level and basement, while Brazilian hardwood, custom inlay flooring, and marble accents showcase the home's quality craftsmanship. The gourmet kitchen features custom Candlelight cherry cabinetry, granite countertops, premium appliances, multiple islands, and an open layout designed for everyday living and entertaining.

The primary suite offers a tray ceiling with artisan-painted inlay, exotic hardwood flooring, a spacious walk-in closet, and a luxurious granite bath. A dedicated wellness retreat features a saltwater spa, infrared sauna, heated tile floors, built-in speakers, and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the backyard.

The finished entertainment area includes a stunning two-tier granite bar with beverage refrigerators, dishwasher, commercial-grade appliances, and generous space to host family and friends.

Step outside to a resort-style backyard complete with a multi-level Unilock patio, covered pavilion, outdoor grilling area, fireplace, fire pit, water feature, landscape lighting, outdoor sound system, and professionally landscaped grounds with an inground sprinkler system.

The heated 4,300 sq ft commercial shop offers four oversized bays, radiant heat, office space, running water, and infrastructure for an automotive lift. Additional highlights include a 50-year metal roof, whole-house Generac generator, smart home technology, central vacuum, and high-efficiency mechanical systems.

A property of this caliber rarely becomes available, offering luxury living, exceptional workspace, and a lifestyle that's nearly impossible to duplicate.
